stageNotes: Stage 1 (canonical): apex https://greatnorthgunco.ca/ returns 200; www redirects to apex (final_url=https://greatnorthgunco.ca/). <link rel=canonical> agrees apex. canonicalOrigin = https://greatnorthgunco.ca.

Stage 2 (WAF/CAPTCHA): hasWaf=false. Server: LiteSpeed origin. No cf-ray, x-sucuri, akamai, incapsula across all 8 batches. Honeypot .env/.git -> 403 from origin LiteSpeed (path-selective at .htaccess, not CDN WAF). SQLi/XSS -> 200. Rapid burst 10x -> all 200, no rate-limit. reCAPTCHA v3 script present in homepage HTML (CF7 plugin, doesn't gate catalog/REST) -> hasCaptcha=false operationally.

Stage 3 (platform): WooCommerce 10.7.0 on WordPress 6.9.4 (generator meta + wp-content + woocommerce-* classes throughout). adapterType=woocommerce. No age-gate. needsPlaywright=false (HTML catalog pages return product cards via plain HTTP). Maintain config derived: verifyMethod=store-api, verifyEndpoint=/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products.

Stage 4 (catalog): WP REST taxonomy /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat?per_page=100&hide_empty=false returned 17 categories, 15 productive (count>0), all top-level (parent=0), all firearm-relevant. Sum of `count` field = 521 (catalog-visible). 15 category URLs picked as catalogUrls. /shop/ aggregator gives same union but per-category is canonical for operator clarity. Extraction quality: 3 sample products from /product-category/used-firearms/ page 1 all have title/url/price/stockStatus populated.

Stage 5 (pagination): Path-style /page/{N}/. Page 2 of /shop/ returned 24 NEW products (zero overlap with page 1). perPage=24 fixed by theme (no ?count/?show/?products-per-page override). Last page = page 22 with 17 products. 21*24+17=521 (matches Store API count). firstPageHasParam=false, startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false.

Stage 6 (sort): <select name=orderby> options: popularity, date (selected default), price, price-desc. 3-outcome test with cache-bust: default first-3 == sorted(date) first-3 ('husqvarna-640', 'anschutz-left-hand', 'winchester-model-1903'); counter(price) first-3 ('enfield-no1-safety-screw', 'enfield-no1-safety-spring-screw', 'enfield-no1-safety-washer'). Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?orderby=date, sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 (watermark): api-date-since-watermark. WP REST core two-probe both HONORED: ?modified_after=2099-01-01 returns x-wp-total:0; ?modified_after=1999-01-01 returns x-wp-total:4299 (matches global). NOTE: WC Store API does NOT honor modified_after (both probes return 521). Runtime WC adapter at woocommerce.ts:337 hardcodes modified_after on WP REST core - correct.

Stage 8 (count): 4299 via wp-rest-header on /wp-json/wp/v2/product. Cross-check: product-sitemap.xml * 5 files = 1001+1000+1000+1000+299 = 4300 -> 4299 minus stylesheet loc. Diverges from Store API 521 (= visible catalog only) and from sum of category count field (also 521). The 3778-product gap is catalog_visibility=hidden (sold-archive listings retained for SEO).

Stage 9 (assembly): All 9 required validator fields present. Stage 7 reason populated. expectedProductCount set to match watermark surface (4299) per skill 'Pick count source to match the watermark surface'. Operator awareness: HTML catalog crawler will see only 521 visible products; watermark crawler will index up to 4299.
